title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Repeat-Error Supplement — Questions Answered
content:
**What decides the repeat-error supplement on a Residential Natural Gas Supply latest-bill rebill credit?**
The repeat-error supplement depends on the rebill credits already standing on the agreement before this one: 10.00 when there are 2 or more, 5.00 when there is exactly one, and no supplement when there are none. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the latest-bill rebill credit.

**Which credits count?**
Every rebill credit line already on the agreement's bill ledger before the credit being posted, whichever line each one corrected. Sign-up credits and renewal loyalty credits are not rebill credits and do not count.

**What are the steps of the scale?**

| Rebill credits already standing on the agreement | Repeat-error supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10.00 |
| exactly 1 | 5.00 |
| none | none |

**An example?** (hypothetical ledger)
An agreement whose ledger shows one rebill credit from last winter and one from last spring has 2 standing, so the supplement is 10.00. Had only the winter credit stood, it would be 5.00.
